requirements.lead_text: Safety and Registration. Do the following:
requirements.req_text: Safety and Registration. Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter during automotive maintenance activities, and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, or lessen these hazards. (b) Discuss with your counselor the safety equipment, tools, and clothing used while checking or repairing a motor vehicle. Use this equipment, tools, and/or clothing (when needed or called for) in meeting the requirements for this merit badge. (c) Explain the different ways motor vehicles are powered. (d) Explain the safety considerations when performing maintenance on a vehicle equipped with a high-voltage electrical system. (e) Review the maintenance chart in the vehicle owner's manual. Explain the requirements and time limits. (f) Explain the purpose, importance, and limitations of safety belts and passive restraints. (g) Find out the requirements for your state's emissions and safety inspections (as applicable), including how often a vehicle needs to be inspected. (h) Explain the importance of registering a vehicle and find out the annual registration fee for renewing your family car's registration.

pamphlet_excerpts: Hazard Prevention: Secure elevated vehicles on rated jack stands before placing any limb underneath.
Eye Protection: Wear ANSI Z87 approved safety glasses during all fluid checks and mechanical work.
Toxicity Control: Collect hazardous fluids in sealed containers to prevent skin contact and environmental runoff.
Electrical Safety: Disconnect the negative battery terminal before servicing any starting or charging circuit components.
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Protective Equipment Setup: Put on ANSI rated safety glasses and chemical resistant nitrile gloves before starting.
Step 2 - Parking Brake Engagement: Shift into park, set the emergency brake, and place chocks behind opposite wheels.
Step 3 - High Voltage Clearance: Check for orange high voltage cables and turn off ignition keys completely.
Step 4 - Documentation Review: Open the vehicle owner manual to locate factory service schedules and registration records.

misconception_pool.fact: Colorless, odorless carbon monoxide accumulates rapidly indoors, so engines should only run outside or with active exhaust hoses.

misconception_pool.misconception: Fuel injectors spray fuel continuously into the engine cylinders regardless of throttle valve position.
misconception_pool.fact: Fuel injection systems utilize electronic control modules to meter precise microsecond fuel pulses matching intake airflow.

misconception_pool.misconception: A severely clogged paper engine air filter causes modern fuel-injected engines to burn way too much raw gasoline per cylinder stroke.
misconception_pool.fact: Modern engine computers measure actual airflow and reduce fuel injection proportionally, so a clogged filter mainly restricts peak power.

misconception_pool.misconception: Electronic fuel injectors stay open continuously like a garden hose nozzle whenever the driver presses the accelerator pedal.
misconception_pool.fact: The engine computer pulses each injector open for precise milliseconds to atomize the exact fuel mass needed for the measured airflow.

misconception_pool.misconception: Running an engine briefly without an air filter in a dusty environment causes no lasting wear because dust burns up in combustion.
misconception_pool.fact: Silica dust is harder than cylinder iron and acts like grinding compound, rapidly scoring piston rings and cylinder walls.

misconception_pool.misconception: The fuel filter is located inside the exhaust tailpipe to trap unburned hydrocarbons before they exit into the atmosphere.
misconception_pool.fact: The fuel filter sits in the fuel line between the tank and injectors to trap rust and dirt, while the catalytic converter cleans exhaust.

misconception_pool.misconception: The vehicle twelve-volt battery powers all onboard electrical accessories while the engine is running.
misconception_pool.fact: The charging system alternator converts mechanical rotation into alternating current before internal diodes rectify it to direct current.

misconception_pool.misconception: The final jumper cable clamp during a jump-start should always be attached directly to the negative post of the dead battery.
misconception_pool.fact: Clamp the final negative lead to an unpainted metal engine bracket away from the battery so any arc cannot ignite vented hydrogen gas.

misconception_pool.misconception: The 12-volt lead-acid battery supplies all electrical power to the headlights, ignition coils, and fuel pump while driving.
misconception_pool.fact: Once the engine starts, the belt-driven alternator powers all vehicle electronics and recharges the battery for the next crank.

misconception_pool.misconception: Connecting spark plug leads in random order has no effect on engine operation as long as every plug receives a high-voltage spark.
misconception_pool.fact: Each cylinder must receive its spark only near top dead center of its compression stroke, or the engine will misfire and backfire.

misconception_pool.misconception: Prying directly against the thin center tip of an iridium spark plug with a coin gauge is the proper way to widen the spark gap.
misconception_pool.fact: Prying against a fine-wire center electrode snaps the brittle tip; gap adjustments must only bend the outer ground strap carefully.

left_points: (9a) Drivetrain Component Architecture: The drivetrain consists of the transmission, driveshafts, universal or constant-velocity joints, differential gears, and drive axles. patrol_quiz_bank.question: You are preparing to crawl beneath a vehicle to inspect the exhaust and suspension for Automotive Maintenance Requirement 1. Which safety procedure is strictly required before anyone goes under the car?
options: A. Raise one corner of the bumper with the emergency scissor jack from the trunk, leave the transmission in neutral.
B. Keep the engine running inside a closed garage to warm the fluids while supporting the frame on hollow concrete cinder blocks.
C. Park on a firm level surface, set the parking brake, chock the wheels, lift the vehicle at manufacturer-specified jack points.
D. Stack wooden two-by-fours on top of a hydraulic floor jack saddle and rely on the hydraulic cylinder pressure alone to hold the vehicle up.
choices: A. Raise one corner of the bumper with the emergency scissor jack from the trunk, leave the transmission in neutral.
B. Keep the engine running inside a closed garage to warm the fluids while supporting the frame on hollow concrete cinder blocks.
C. Park on a firm level surface, set the parking brake, chock the wheels, lift the vehicle at manufacturer-specified jack points.
D. Stack wooden two-by-fours on top of a hydraulic floor jack saddle and rely on the hydraulic cylinder pressure alone to hold the vehicle up.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: C. Park on a firm level surface, set the parking brake, chock the wheels, lift the vehicle at manufacturer-specified jack points, and lower it onto rated mechanical jack stands before going underneath.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (C): Hydraulic jacks can fail or leak pressure without warning; a vehicle must always be supported on properly rated mechanical jack stands on level ground with wheels chocked before anyone works beneath it.
